company.text: Bruker makes high-performance scientific instruments and analytical/diagnostic solutions. Since Jul 1, 2026 it reports four segments: **Biosystems (BIOS)**, **Microbiology & Infection Diagnostics (BMID)**, **NANO** and **BEST**. Its **Bruker Spatial Biology** unit (from the NanoString acquisition) sells **CosMx SMI** (spatial transcriptomics), **GeoMx DSP** (region-based multiomics), **CellScape XR** (spatial proteomics), **PaintScape** (3D genome) and **AtoMx** informatics; at AGBT in Feb 2026 it added a mouse whole-transcriptome CosMx assay and a Spatial Biology Center of Excellence with the University of Glasgow.
